court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Sutter
case_search_note: Tyler public portal linked from the court's Online Case Access page. No registration required; current cases and completed cases back to 2008; shows case details and upcoming hearing dates; can pay criminal/traffic fines. Confidential cases are not online — you must search for those in person at the courthouse. Public computers are also available at the courthouse.

courthouses.name: Sutter County Superior Courthouse
courthouses.note: The court's only listed location — handles criminal (felony and misdemeanor), traffic, juvenile, civil, family, probate and small claims. Traffic line (530) 822-3303 (Traffic/Criminal Processing, 8:30–4:30). In-custody arraignments are heard daily at 3:00 p.m. per the Criminal Division page. Self-Help (530) 822-3305; self-help computers in the lobby outside Room 120.

public_defenders.name: Sutter County Public Defender
public_defenders.note: Represents people charged with crimes in Sutter County who can't afford a lawyer, including juveniles; request appointment at your first court appearance. The court page says appointed counsel may be the Public Defender or Conflict Counsel.
public_defenders.todo: sutter.gov returns 403 to automated fetches; address/phone taken from search-index text of the official page — confirm in a browser. Hours not found.

legal_aid.name: California Rural Legal Assistance (CRLA) — Marysville office
legal_aid.serves: Low-income residents (office is in neighboring Marysville, Yuba County)
legal_aid.what: Civil legal aid; CRLA's site lists 'Criminal Record Clearing' among its help categories. Office page does not list which counties it serves or detail record-clearing services. Not criminal defense on open cases.
legal_aid.note: 511 D St, Marysville, CA 95901. Tue & Thu 9–12, 1–5; Mon/Wed/Fri by phone or appointment only.
legal_aid.todo: Confirm CRLA Marysville serves Sutter County residents and does record clearing there.

legal_aid.name: Sutter Superior Court Self-Help Center
legal_aid.what: Free help with family law, child support, guardianship, small claims and CARE Act petitions. Its page says it helps with non-criminal problems — does not mention record clearing.
legal_aid.note: Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–3:30 p.m. (in person and phone).

probation.name: Sutter County Probation — Adult Probation & Adult Resource Center
probation.note: Fax (530) 822-7470. Monthly reports may be emailed to suttermonthlyreports@sutter.gov. Juvenile probation is separate: 430 Center Street, (530) 822-4371.
probation.todo: sutter.gov returns 403 to automated fetches; details from search-index text of the official page — confirm in a browser.

programs.name: Pretrial Services (Sutter County Probation)
programs.summary: Probation runs a Pretrial Services Program (started 2013) and, per its SB 36/AB 3364 compliance page, uses the Public Safety Assessment (PSA) risk tool and gives that information to the court for release decisions.
programs.todo: Page blocked automated fetch; check-in conditions not published.

programs.name: Adult Drug Court / Prop 36 Supervision
programs.summary: Sutter County Probation lists an Adult Drug Court and Proposition 36 Supervision among its specialized programs. The court's own website does not describe a drug court. Ask your attorney about eligibility.
programs.todo: Found only in search-index text of Sutter County pages (blocked to direct fetch); eligibility, schedule and contact unconfirmed.

programs.name: Court Self-Help Center
programs.summary: Free information for people without a lawyer (family, child support, guardianship, small claims, CARE Act). Not for criminal defense.

jails.name: Sutter County Jail (Main Jail)
jails.address: 1077 Civic Center Blvd., Yuba City, CA 95993
jails.phone_note: Jail Division main line. Commissary packages via Access Securepak 1-800-546-6283. Phone account deposits 1-800-844-6591 (24/7).
jails.note: Visiting schedule lists both Male and Female General Population (houses both). Visits are non-contact, 30 minutes, sign up in person before visiting hours. Jail accepts money for an incarcerated person's account 24 hours a day. The county has only one courthouse, so in-custody cases are heard there (custody arraignments daily 3:00 p.m.).

jails.name: Tri-County Youth Development Center (Tri-County Youth Rehabilitation Campus)
jails.phone_note: Ext. 2 Juvenile Hall, ext. 3 Camp Singer.
jails.note: Run by Yuba County Probation; campus serves Yuba, Sutter and Colusa counties (32-bed secure detention). Located in Yuba County. Court mapping is nearest, not confirmed — Sutter juvenile cases are Sutter Superior Court cases.

inmate_lookup_note: Sheriff's 'Incarcerated Person Search' (charges, bail, visiting schedule) is linked from this page; VINELink (vinelink.com → California → Sutter County) also shows custody status and offers alerts.

bail.note: Use the CA Department of Insurance license check to confirm any bail agent is licensed. Court bail schedules: https://www.sutter.courts.ca.gov/forms-filing/bail-schedules. The judge may raise, lower or set bail at arraignment. Where/how to post cash bail at the Sutter County Jail was not confirmed from an official page.
